diagnostics.message: kubectl_manifest.karpenter_provisioner creates a Karpenter Provisioner whose spec.providerRef.name is the literal string "default", which refers to the AWSNodeTemplate named "default" created by kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template. Because that reference is just text inside the yaml_body heredoc, Terraform infers no ordering between the two resources — both only depend on module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons and can be applied concurrently, so the Provisioner can be reconciled before its provider template exists. karpenter_provisioner should depend on karpenter_node_template (e.g. via an explicit depends_on, since no clean attribute on the node_template is available to reference).
